reason: This plugin is primarily for desktop-to-mobile UI access adaptation: it exposes an existing DeepSeek Harness web service to phones via a share server and applies mobile-focused UI injection. Evidence from README and package metadata shows the plugin is a DSH web bundle with client injection, not a general automation, code-generation, or data-processing tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将本地 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面以可配置方式共享到手机浏览器，并通过注入式界面适配提升移动端的可用性。
summaries.en: The plugin shares a local DeepSeek Harness Web UI to mobile browsers with configurable settings, while injecting a mobile-oriented interface so the web experience works better on phones.

capabilities: Expose a local web UI for mobile access over LAN
Provide optional public access flow via cloudflared tunnel
Inject client-side mobile UI adjustments into existing pages
Collect and apply share settings such as port and credentials
Expose file/workspace selection controls in the mobile UI

reasons.code: README states the plugin turns the PC into a server with a reverse proxy so iPhone/Android/tablet can reach the local DeepSeek Harness UI.
README describes optional public access via one-click cloudflared tunnel plus port and credential settings, firewall rule, QR code, and share self-test.
README describes server-side viewport/CSS/JS injection for mobile-specific UI behavior (top bar, composer placement, workspace picker).
package.json declares a DSH web client bundle with runtime client injection, confirming the plugin modifies the active client experience.
Validation report indicates manifest/packing checks did not pass, so admission readiness is currently blocked until package and manifest metadata issues are fixed.
